Murder at the Village Fete

A Cozy Mystery Word Search: 10 Chapters, 50 Puzzles, 1 Killer

Little Whitcombe's village fete has cake, bunting and a brass band. By four o'clock it also has a body. Gerald Thwaite, chairman of everything, has judged his last Victoria sponge, and five of his neighbours had a reason to wish him gone. Aggie Penrose, 72, retired crossword setter and incurable noticer of things, means to find out which of them did it.

This is a story you solve. Read a short scene, then work through five word searches. Every grid hides one extra clue word that is not on the word list. Find it, write it in your case notebook, cross off a suspect, and name the killer before the final chapter.
